channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: Revelation raises questions about reporting from Gaza
item.description: Motaz Azaiza says he filmed Gazans assaulting hostages but withheld the footage out of concern that Israel would identify them. He also revealed pressure exerted by Hamas on journalists.

item.title: Trump: Claims by 'traitors' US low on munitions not true
item.description:
US resident Donald Trump dismissed claims that the US is running low on munitions as "not true" and spread by "traitors."
Trump wrote on Truth Social: "The cowards and traitors would love to say the United States is low on munitions. It's not true. We have more munitions than we could ever possibly think of using, and are building them up now at levels we have never seen before. President DONALD J. TRUMP"

item.title: Iran’s foreign minister asks US for security protection in New York
item.description: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has requested US security protection during the UN General Assembly, with the State Department agreeing to provide Diplomatic Security Service personnel after a threat assessment.

item.title: Bibi Derangement Syndrome is, in fact, deranged
item.description: Ultimately it represents a willingness to denigrate and diminish Israel itself. Opinion.

item.title: Injured Balad leader denied delay in disqualification hearing
item.description: Judge Noam Sohlberg rejects Sami Abu Shehadeh’s request to postpone the hearing over his hospitalization, allowing him to participate remotely as Otzma Yehudit pushes to block his Knesset candidacy.

item.title: The Four Species of Israel’s economy
item.description: On Sukkot, we bind together four very different species. Their differences do not disappear. Together, however, they become a mitzvah. There is a lesson here.

item.title: ‘I’m going to tell the truth about you’: Netanyahu fires back at Mamdani
item.description: Netanyahu blasts NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani over his accusations against Israel and vows to “tell the truth" about him during his upcoming UN address.

item.title: The holy city of Tel Aviv
item.description: A Jew may appear non-religious on the outside, but in the depths of his soul burns the flame of Torah and the yearning for a full life blessed with closeness to Hashem.

item.title: Report: Iran's offer to reopen the Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Senior Iranian official says Tehran could reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days if Washington eases military pressure and its blockade of Iranian ports.

item.title: ‘For the sin of genocide’: Anti-Israel groups hold Yom Kippur ‘Yizkor’
item.description: Over 1,500 activists join a Yom Kippur “Yizkor" event accusing Israel of genocide, before protesters block the Brooklyn Bridge and dozens are arrested.

item.title: Defense Minister: 'If even one Israeli is captured, Gaza City will be emptied'
item.description: Defense Minister Israel Katz issued a series of sharp warnings to Hamas and its supporters, including Iran and Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan.

item.title: Yom Kippur synagogue honors fetch record sums
item.description: Yom Kippur synagogue auctions reach new heights as worshipers pay tens of thousands for honors, with one Book of Jonah reading fetching 353,000 shekels.

item.title: Israeli sentenced to 4.5 years for spying on Defense Minister
item.description: A Haifa court sentenced Pars Abu al-Hij'a to four and a half years in prison after he admitted to carrying out missions for an Iranian intelligence agent.

item.title: Criminal complaint filed against IDF soldier vacationing in Tuscany
item.description: Hind Rajab Foundation files a criminal complaint in Italy against an Israeli soldier vacationing in Tuscany, alleging crimes during operations in Gaza.

item.title: An eight-step guide to blaming Israel
item.description: How to explain the Middle East without the inconvenience of history, complexity or Palestinian agency. Opinion.

item.title: ‘Yoav, run!’: Teen recounts watching terrorist murder his father
item.description: Sixteen-year-old Yoav Shakron recounts seeing a terrorist shoot his father Netanel, fleeing under fire and returning minutes later to find him dead.

item.title: Canadian teen arrested after threatening synagogue
item.description: A 19-year-old man has been arrested after Durham Regional Police say he allegedly threatened online to carry out a shooting at a synagogue in the Durham Region.

item.title: Strangling Iran: Will Trump’s endgame win out?
item.description: The pressing issue is whether Washington can tie its measures together so financial pressure becomes a noose that follows Iranian trade on the sea, in the air, through banks and possibly across land borders too. Opinion.

item.title: The ‘kol dichfin’ call of Sukkot
item.description: The sukkah is fragile and temporary, but the welcome we create within it can be strong and lasting.

item.title: US Military split on Houthi strikes as Saudi Arabia seeks Trump’s help
item.description: US military leaders are reportedly divided over striking the Houthis as Saudi Arabia seeks more help and Trump weighs renewed military action in Yemen.

item.title: 'The sword is coming. The time to warn the people is now.'
item.description: The prophet Ezekiel said that the watchman who does not warn of coming dangers is responsible for the ensuing catastrophe. A call to first-time voters: the key to pre-empting the Left’s dirty tricks to steal the forthcoming Israeli elections. Opinion.

item.title: Witness recounts terror attack on Yom Kippur eve
item.description: Nehemiah Hazan came to the spring near Neve Tzuf for a pre-Yom Kippur immersion. Minutes later, he found himself trapped at the scene of a deadly attack that claimed the life of Netanel Shakron.

item.title: US Amb. to Canada: All Canadians should be able to worship without worrying for their safety
item.description:
US Ambassador to Canada Pete Hoekstra issued a message of support for the Jewish community following the shooting outside a synagogue in Belleville, Ontario.
"My thoughts and those of the American people are with the Jewish Community in Belleville following the attack on the Sons of Jacob Synagogue as they commemorated Yom Kippur, the holiest day of the Jewish year. All Canadians should be able to worship without worrying for their safety. The United States has offered assistance to support Canadian law enforcement and the Jewish community," Hoekstra stated.

item.title: UK to provide Saudi Arabia with aerial refueling capabilities for limited period
item.description:
British Prime Minister Andy Burnham announced that he had agreed to Saudi Arabia’s request to provide aerial refueling capabilities for defensive purposes for a limited period.
Bloomberg previously reported that Burnham was considering providing operational assistance to the Saudi military in confronting the Houthis and working with other countries to enlist their support in efforts to curb the rebels in Yemen.

item.title: G7 countries call on Iran to stop supporting the Houthis
item.description:
The foreign ministers of the G7 countries called on Iran to halt its supply of weapons and support to the Houthi rebels in Yemen. They said the Houthis’ activities were creating a dangerous pattern of escalation that threatened international trade and global stability.
“We strongly condemn the ongoing and unacceptable attacks carried out by the Houthis in Yemen and against Saudi Arabia," the foreign ministers of the United States, Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Japan and the United Kingdom said after meeting on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly.

item.title: Reports of Israeli strike in southern Lebanon
item.description: Lebanese media are reporting an Israeli airstrike in the Wadi Saluki area in southern Lebanon.

item.title: Trump holds meetings on Iran: They’re not gonna have a nuclear weapon
item.description: President Trump says he will hold meetings on Iran as Tehran warns the war is not over and vows to change its weapons, tactics and targets.

item.title: Trump praises Mamdani: He’s certainly got potential
item.description: President Trump praises New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani as having “great potential" ahead of their third meeting at Gracie Mansion.

item.description: Minister Amichai Chikli attends a toast hosted by “HaHazakim Mitgalim" nonprofit in Herzliya, meets wounded IDF veterans, and joins them for a surfing session.
